criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name the three installations, quote the official phrase verbatim, and signal a correction in under 210 chars with zero snark. Minor deduction: Moriarty's name appears in paragraph 2, not the hook, so the hook says 'a Deputy Assistant Secretary' rather than naming him.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Claim affects active bidders against a named 29 May RFP deadline. Correction identifies the pro-forma rebuild trigger, names all three installations, links to AK policymakers championing the deal, and explains post-award stall risk. Sector, contract vehicle, and consequence all concrete.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Paragraph 2 generously covers Enhanced Use Lease precedent, DoD edge-AI demand, and the rational developer calculus for treating free land as an enabling condition. Reader who believed the PPP framing feels fairly represented. Marginally thinner than the dossier steelman but substantive and unsnarky.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Every rebuttal point traces to the RFP's own 'no obligation' clause, reproduced verbatim via ClearanceJobs (14 April), marked primary in the dossier. Logic airtight, source is the governing document. Deduction: only one counter-evidence entry, so all rebuttal points derive from a single source chain.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics throughout: Moriarty's title, Air and Space Forces Magazine, 11 April, RFP release 10 April, ClearanceJobs 14 April, Eielson AFB, Clear SFS, JBER, 29 May deadline, 100% risk on lessee. Connective frame paragraph slightly less dense than the every-1-to-2-sentence standard.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attribution is primary (named Deputy Assistant Secretary in Air and Space Forces Magazine with date). Counter cites ClearanceJobs quoting the RFP verbatim (is_primary true). Both sides sourced. Deduction: only one counter-evidence source.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical and position-taking throughout, business-literate (offtake, pro forma, underwriting, anchor tenant, lessee), structural transitions, corrective not contemptuous. No influencer cadence, no dunking, no hype. No noticeable voice drift from post_001.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 427 words and 2789 chars within spec. Paragraphs 2-5 sentences; para 2 runs 5 but flows as a coherent steelman block. Bullet block 4 single-clause items. Scannable on mobile and desktop.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closing question is specific (Eielson or Clear bankable before the deadline), tied to the corrected frame, genuinely debatable, no rhetorical softener or CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Penultimate paragraph names the actionable reader (a bidder who modeled DoD as anchor tenant) and the precise decision to reframe (rebuild the pro forma before 29 May). AK policymakers named as a second reader group with a reframing trigger.

one_sentence_fix: If a second primary source corroborating the no-obligation clause becomes available (e.g., the SAM.gov RFP document or a DoD IG report), add it to the dossier and cite it so the rebuttal rests on two independent primary chains.
